title: Make the coder test-execution skill neutral about session type and integration owner
outcome: Make the coder test-execution skill neutral about session type and integration owner
acceptance: Step 4 of the skill chooses the completion route by what the project supports for this session, so a delegated coder that can't use a host run wait is told to disclose it
Step 6 no longer assumes an integration owner exists in every project, and doesn't tell a coder in a project without one to skip the whole-suite run with nobody named to run it
The Engram and TermAl copies stay byte-identical
